name: RELX PLC
summary: RELX PLC, together with its subsidiaries, provides information-based analytics and decision tools for professional and business customers in North America, Europe, and internationally. verdict: Einstufung: Qualität (Buffett-Typ) – erfüllt 9/9 Buffett-Kriterien – stabiler, profitabler Burggraben. Buffett-Score 80/100 (Starker Buffett-Kandidat), Innovations-Score 32/100 (Noch zu früh/zu teuer). Geschätzter fairer Wert ≈ 42.74 USD (+6 % zum Kurs). Risiko: Niedrig.
